title: Training Note for Member Services: Holding Limits and Acceptance of Custom Application and Field Services Plans
content:
A member may hold up to three plans under Custom Application and Field Services at once, counting every plan that is neither completed nor cancelled, because a farm commonly runs one plan for the home ground, another for rented acres in a different township, and a separate certified plan for anhydrous. Two live plans of the same programme for the same crop year are never written for one member, since the committed acres and the rate lock would then sit in two places.

A plan whose entry gate calls for licence verification is not accepted until the licence covering restricted-use application has been verified for the crop year and recorded against the plan, and the verification is taken from the licence itself rather than from the member's word that it was renewed. A plan whose entry gate calls for a prescription is not accepted until a current prescription is on file. Where the entry gate is not met the enrolment is taken and the plan waits in applied standing, and work is written on the Per-Acre Custom Application programme in the meantime at the posted rate.

## The two figures the limit rests on

| What is counted | The figure |
|---|---|
| Live plans one member may hold at once, counting every plan neither completed nor cancelled | 3 |
| What makes two plans the same for the purposes of the uniqueness rule | the programme and the crop year, taken together |

## Points of judgement

*A member holds two live plans and one that completed in the spring. How many count?* Two. A completed plan is not counted, and neither is a cancelled one, so the member stands two below the limit of 3 rather than one.

*A member holds a Season Commitment Application Plan for the current crop year and asks for a second one for the same crop year.* That is the same programme and the same crop year, so a second live plan of it is not written for that member. A Season Commitment Application Plan for a different crop year, or a different programme for the same crop year, is not the same plan on this test.

*Where does the licence verification come from?* From the licence, recorded against the plan for the crop year. What the member says about a renewal is not the verification, and the plan is not accepted on it. The verification is looked for against the plan the enrolment concerns, identified by its plan number, and it is looked for before the plan is accepted rather than afterwards.

*What becomes of an enrolment whose entry gate is unmet?* It is taken, and the plan waits in applied standing. Work for that member in the meantime is written on the Per-Acre Custom Application programme at the posted rate.
